group.name: FriendlyScore
group.description: FriendlyScore is a SaaS B2B scoring solution that enables online lenders to perform user-permissioned checks on borrowers based on social media and online records, IP verification, and browsing history analysis. It collects data from LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook, with the imminent additions of Paypal, and bank APIs. FriendlyScore offers an alternative approach to credit scoring that is used to assess thinner-file borrowers such as students, foreign nationals, and underbanked populations.
